e: From the Hanyu Pinyin romanization of the Mandarin 辟邪 (bìxié).
From BIX (“Byte Information Exchange”) + -ie, a BBS on which these emoticons became popular.
q: But when it comes to short hairstyles such as the pixie and bixie cut (a mix of elements from both bobs and pixie cuts), we're often left scratching our heads as soon as we leave the salon.
